row.notes: mov rax,[rax] after Gdb_Get_FieldInt(row,stat_id,0) in FeTile_Check_EntrantListUsable: rax = the returned slot pointer. For a label with no row the pointer is the database miss pointer and [rax] is 0x08000f000800000e (non-canonical), which the following test rax,rax passes and movzx r14d,[rax+8] at 0x14242883a faults on.

verify.notes: V8628 own disasm: 142428832 mov rax,[rax] (3 bytes) after call Gdb_Get_FieldInt at 14242882d; rax is its returned pointer. test rax,rax at 142428835 lies in the 5-byte window but has no inbound branch (je 14242883f targets 83f). Reading [rax] in the guard is the same load the game does. Same rsp as at function entry+frame (calls balanced), so the jump to 1424288d7 is safe.
